trigger_doc_count: ..  documents in Paperless: {count} (the webhook will decide which to skip)
trigger_skipping_watch_folder: ..  skipping {count} file(s) from {folder} (the watcher's own folder)
trigger_already_uploaded: ..  {path} - already uploaded as id={doc_id} under a different path, skipping
dup_fetching: ..  fetching documents from Paperless (with OCR text - content is already in the API)...
dup_image_count: nearly no text (comparing by page phash): {count}
dup_missing_image_deps: !!  imagehash/PyMuPDF/Pillow are not installed - skipping {count} document(s) with nearly no text (pip install imagehash --break-system-packages)
dup_hashing: ..  downloading and hashing {count} document(s) with nearly no text (in parallel, {workers} threads)...
dup_none_found: OK  no duplicates found (text threshold {text_threshold}, image threshold {image_threshold} - try loosening them if you expected more).
dup_image_matches_header: !!  image matches (documents with nearly no text, phash): {count}
google_auth_test_task_created: OK  test task created (id={task_id}) in list '{list_name}' - check Google Tasks and delete it by hand.
